text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"extended opening scenario and clear stance","quality":"argumentative focus","description":"It presents a more sustained position and keeps returning to the claim that driverless cars are harmful."},{"evidence":"“Some manufacturers hope to do that…” and “who is at fault” discussion","quality":"use of source evidence","description":"It supports its claims with several specific references to the article rather than mostly broad opinion."},{"evidence":"counterargument paragraph beginning “Many individuals will argue…”","quality":"acknowledgment of opposing views","description":"It recognizes likely support for driverless cars and responds to those claims instead of ignoring them."},{"evidence":"multiple body paragraphs with clear opening and ending","quality":"organization","description":"It has a more developed structure with an introduction, body development, and conclusion that are easier to follow."},{"evidence":"“laziness of society,” “rise in accidents,” “complicated conflicts with the law”","quality":"idea development","description":"It explains several reasons and consequences in fuller detail rather than making brief unsupported statements."},{"evidence":"“accidents have been prevented because the driver was quick and smart enough”","quality":"reasoning","description":"It more often connects evidence to a larger point about human judgment and safety."}]}
